title: xeraea vaga
intro: Xeraea vaga, commonly known as Desert Lavender, is a type of flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions including sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its calming and soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of Xeraea vaga include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
